title: AdvancedHUD
description: A unified HUD mod that does a lot of things!
body:
[AdvancedHUD](https://skyknightyt.net/personal/projects/mods/advancedhud/) is a mod that can be shaped and bent to anyone's will. Built on the [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/) modding platform, it is designed to be lightweight and resource efficient. While I have tried to minimise external dependencies, it requires
[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) to work.

AdvancedHUD aims to eliminate the need of 3rd party libraries (aside from Fabric API) and also reduce resource usage by cutting down the extra code that is inherently copy-pasted between different individual mods with minor changes because they need them to work individually.

There are a lot of popular, customisable and somewhat resource efficient HUD mods out there, however they all lack one key detail, they are not unified and in some cases overlap, causing unexpected behaviour. Furthermore, most of these mods are created by different individuals or teams. Each one of them have their own way, preferences and design choices of making said mods, which may, make the user experience less clean overall. Another key detail to mention is that some of these mods require other library mods as (optional) dependencies, which adds unnecessary resource usage.

AdvancedHUD currently as of version 0.2.1 has the following features/can show the following:

- FPS
- Coordinates
- Direction
- Ping
- Armor

The features can be turned on/off individually and removes the need of having a separate mod specifically for displaying armor.

**Disclaimer:**

AdvancedHUD is still under development. New features and versions may take some time to release as there is only [me ](https://modrinth.com/user/SKY_KNIGHT_YT) as the sole developer.

AdvancedHUD is a name taken by, in my knowledge at least 3 projects including mine. I do not intend on impersonating or affiliating with said projects.

These projects are:

- [Advanced HUD - By Razuuu](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-hud)
- [Advanced HUD - By Yigitguven](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedhud)

**Important:**
Some of you may notice that the ModID of my mod is the same as [Advanced HUD - By Razuuu](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-hud), worry not as I have asked permission for usage of said ModID from Razuuu. You can find my interaction with him [here](https://github.com/Razuuu/Razuuu/issues/1).
